subject: english

answer.explanation: light and night share the final /aɪt/ sound, so they rhyme. Similar spelling alone is not enough.

solutionStrategy: 比較字尾的發音，不只看字母拼法。
solutionSteps: Listen to the final stressed sound.
Match night because its ending sound is /aɪt/.
Reject late even though its spelling begins similarly.
